run_train_resnet50_pets: run the cv_example script to train a ResNet50 model on the Oxford-IIT Pet Dataset using Accelerate
create_accelerator_training: create an Accelerator instance with mixed precision and CPU/GPU/TPU support for distributed training
build_pets_dataset: build a PyTorch Dataset class that loads JPEG images and extracts labels from filenames
test_distributed_training: test the training script across single GPU, multi-GPU, and TPU configurations
run_mixed_precision_training: run the training script with fp16 or bf16 mixed precision via --mixed_precision argument
